purpose: Classify normalized Project Status review entries by explicit reviewKey/code rules and declared evidence only. No text similarity, name JOIN, filename inference, chronology inference, or semantic recomputation is allowed.

policy.partialResolutionCountBounds: remainingCount must be between zero and reportedCount

evidenceContract.key: An exact selected-field key already declared by Project Status normalization

countContract.reportedCount: Immutable count from the primary review entry when present
countContract.remainingCount: Optional literal count set by an exact lifecycle rule after evidence passes
countContract.remainingCountFromEvidence: Optional sourceRole/key reference to an already declared selected count
countContract.resolvedCount: Derived only as reportedCount minus remainingCount
countContract.partialResolution: ACTIVE_REVIEW may retain health impact with a remainingCount below reportedCount
